notes: Read SKILL.md and references/helm-commands.md in full. Helm guide: chart layout, Chart.yaml/values.yaml, deployment/helper/ingress templates, install/upgrade/rollback/uninstall, chart development, repositories, hooks, tests, library charts, and OCI registries.

Following it can make the agent run helm commands that install, upgrade, roll back, and uninstall releases in whatever cluster kubectl points to, add chart repositories and install third-party charts (bitnami/postgresql), and log in/push to an OCI registry. Medium because these change cluster state and pull remote charts; acceptable because they are standard Helm workflows for the user's own cluster, with --dry-run and helm template shown for previewing, and nothing that disables security controls.
